verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for a hosted code platform, but the evidence pack never documents user-configurable retention policies or deletion controls. The closest items are GDPR/SOC2 compliance claims and encryption at rest, which are adjacent privacy features rather than retention or deletion controls. Community reports of Bitbucket deleting Mercurial repos describe a vendor decision, not a user-controlled capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
